# QR code

Draw a QR code in the terminal; save it as PNG (Ctrl+S, --out).

Category: Encoders · ID: `qr` · Search terms: qrcode, barcode, png, image

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui qr [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Text or URL

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--level` | `L`, `M`, `Q`, `H` | `M` | Recovery. Error correction: L 7 %, M 15 %, Q 25 %, H 30 % |
| `--invert` | on/off | `false` | Light terminal. Draw dark modules as blocks, for terminals with a light background |
| `--size` | 64–4096 | `512` | PNG size. Width and height of the PNG in pixels |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/qr`), so they are what the tool prints.
